topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: Rain's been drummin' on the glass all evenin'. Got this place on the brain, y'know? Used to slip in there, get my usual. Nobody judged, just the sizzle of the kitchen and the faint clink of glasses. Heard it's takin' its last call, though. Feel like I've lost track of somethin' I couldn't afford to lose. Guess I'll have to find another corner, another plate that hits the spot. But it ain't the same when you know the recipe's lost, the hands that made it gone. Somethin' sittin' heavy in my chest, like last night's whiskey. Gonna miss that place, more than I want to admit.
